// NEGATIVE fixture — `AbortSignal.` only where a lexer must not see it.
import { makeAbortController } from '../../../lib/fetch-compat.mjs';

// A line comment: AbortSignal.timeout(ms)
/* A block comment: AbortSignal.any([a, b]) */
const SINGLE = 'AbortSignal.timeout(ms)';
const DOUBLE = "AbortSignal.any([a, b])";
const TEMPLATE = `a timer plus abort(), never AbortSignal.timeout(ms)`;
const IN_REGEX = /AbortSignal\./;

class AbortSignalShim {}

export function mentionsAbortSignalStatic(source) {
  return /AbortSignal\./.test(source);
}

export function timeoutSignal(ms) {
  // Near-miss in real code: `AbortSignalShim` carries no dot, so the ban does not fire.
  const shimName = AbortSignalShim;
  void shimName;
  const controller = makeAbortController();
  setTimeout(function () { controller.abort(); }, ms);
  return controller.signal;
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX, AbortSignalShim };
